function barraCorda(a,b,yA,yB){const va=new THREE.Vector3(a.x,a.y+yA,a.z),vb=new THREE.Vector3(b.x,b.y+yB,b.z);const d=vb.clone().sub(va);
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.045,.045,d.length(),5),cordaMat);mesh.position.copy(va).add(vb).multiplyScalar(.5);mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),d.normalize());cordao.add(mesh);}

  for(const side of [-1,1]){
    let anterior=null;const steps=Math.ceil(len/3.3);
    for(let i=0;i<=steps;i++){
      const t=i/steps,x=a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*t-dz*side*CORTEJO_LARGURA,z=a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*t+dx*side*CORTEJO_LARGURA;
      const base=cordaoPonto(x,z),poste=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.085,.11,1.2,7),posteMat);
      poste.position.copy(base).add(new THREE.Vector3(0,.6,0));cordao.add(poste);

function rotaDistancia(x,z){let best={d:1e9,x:0,z:0};
  for(let i=1;i<PATH.length;i++){const a=PATH[i-1],b=PATH[i],vx=b[0]-a[0],vz=b[1]-a[1];
    const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-a[0])*vx+(z-a[1])*vz)/(vx*vx+vz*vz)));
    const qx=a[0]+vx*t,qz=a[1]+vz*t,d=Math.hypot(x-qx,z-qz);
    if(d<best.d)best={d,x:qx,z:qz};}return best;}
function processionAtiva(){return CORTEJO.state===1||CORTEJO.state===2;}
function bloquearTravessia(lx,lz){if(!processionAtiva())return;
  const distanciaPasso=Math.hypot(P.x-lx,P.z-lz);
  // Evita atravessar a faixa de um lado a outro, inclusive em deslocamentos grandes.
  if(distanciaPasso>2*CORTEJO_LARGURA){
    const passos=Math.ceil(distanciaPasso/1.8);
    for(let i=1;i<=passos;i++){
      const t=i/passos,p=rotaDistancia(lx+(P.x-lx)*t,lz+(P.z-lz)*t);
      if(p.d<CORTEJO_LARGURA+.4){P.x=lx;P.z=lz;return;}
    }
  }
  const perto=rotaDistancia(P.x,P.z);if(perto.d>=CORTEJO_LARGURA+.4)return;
  // Se a posição anterior era segura, desfazemos apenas o passo que atravessaria a corda.
  const anterior=rotaDistancia(lx,lz);
  if(anterior.d>=CORTEJO_LARGURA+.4){P.x=lx;P.z=lz;return;}
  // Recuperação para jogadores reposicionados por atalhos ou colisões de construções.
  let dx=P.x-perto.x,dz=P.z-perto.z,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz);
  if(d<.001){dx=0;dz=1;d=1;}
  P.x=perto.x+dx/d*(CORTEJO_LARGURA+.52);P.z=perto.z+dz/d*(CORTEJO_LARGURA+.52);
}

function placeProc(dt){
  for(const m of PROC){const ss=CORTEJO.s+5-m.off;   // D. João (off 5) é a referência
    if(CORTEJO.state<2||(ss<-.01&&CORTEJO.state<3)){m.f.g.visible=false;if(m.tag)m.tag.visible=false;continue;}
    if(m.hide){m.f.g.visible=false;if(m.tag)m.tag.visible=false;continue;}
    const p=pathAt(ss),x=p.x-p.nz*m.lat,z=p.z+p.nx*m.lat;
    m.f.g.visible=true;m.f.g.position.set(x,H(x,z),z);m.f.g.rotation.y=Math.atan2(p.nx,p.nz);
    m.f.anim(dt,CORTEJO.state===2?CORTEJO.speed:0);
    if(m.tag){m.tag.visible=true;m.tag.position.set(x,H(x,z)+m.ty,z);}}
  const j=DJOAO.f.g;PALIO.visible=j.visible;PALIO.position.copy(j.position);PALIO.rotation.y=j.rotation.y;}

let nearPlace=null,quiet=null;
function showCard(p){
  if(p&&needsPlaceLesson(p)){if(nearPlace===p)return;nearPlace=p;inviteLesson(p);return;}
  if(nearPlace===p)return;nearPlace=p;if(!p){$('card').hidden=true;return;}p.pg=0;
  if(S.seen[p.id])p.ring.material.color.set(0x7cc08a);
  refreshCard();}
function recordDiscovery(p){if(!p||S.seen[p.id])return;
  S.seen[p.id]=1;if(p.id==='valongo')S.valongo=true;
  if(p.ring)p.ring.material.color.set(0x7cc08a);
  renderTasks();refreshCard();}
function refreshCard(){const p=nearPlace;if(!p)return;const k=p.pg||0,n=p.pages.length;
  $('cardTitle').textContent=p.t;$('cardSub').textContent=p.sub;
  let extra='';if(p.id==='castelo'&&!S.end&&!allButEnd())extra='<p class="fb no">Complete as outras tarefas do dia. Depois você poderá esperar o anoitecer aqui.</p>';
  if(p.id==='capela'&&(!S.arrived||!S.procSeen))extra='<p class="fb no">'+(!S.landed?'O príncipe ainda não desembarcou. Vá primeiro ao cais.':!S.procSeen?'Antes, observe a procissão no ponto dourado do Largo do Paço.':'A procissão ainda está a caminho. Espere a chegada ao fim do percurso.')+'</p>';
  $('cardText').innerHTML=p.pages[k]+(k===0?extra:'')+(n>1?`<div class="pg">${k+1} / ${n}</div>`:'');
  const B=$('cardBtns');B.innerHTML='';const a=p.act&&p.act();
  if(a){const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=a.l+' (E)';b.onclick=a.f;B.appendChild(b);}
  // A visita é registrada automaticamente após a leitura e a resposta correta.
  if(n>1){const m=document.createElement('button');m.className=a?'ghost':'';m.textContent=k<n-1?'Mais ▸'+(a?'':' (E)'):'◂ Voltar ao início';m.onclick=()=>{p.pg=k<n-1?k+1:0;refreshCard();};B.appendChild(m);}
  $('card').hidden=false;}
function cardMsg(html){$('cardText').innerHTML=html;$('cardBtns').innerHTML='';}

let dlgClose=null;
function setBtns(btns){const B=$('dBtns');B.innerHTML='';

// Síntese de voz nativa do navegador: texto em português, sem API externa.
const VOICE={auto:false,available:'speechSynthesis' in window&&'SpeechSynthesisUtterance' in window};
function voiceStop(){if(VOICE.available)window.speechSynthesis.cancel();}
function voiceRead(){
 if(!VOICE.available){toast('<b>Voz indisponível</b>Este navegador não oferece leitura em voz alta.');return;}
 voiceStop();const src=$('dTxt').cloneNode(true);
 src.querySelectorAll('.ix,.readingTip,.pg,button').forEach(x=>x.remove());
 const text=[ $('dWho').textContent,src.textContent.trim()].filter(Boolean).join('. ');
 if(!text.trim())return;
 const u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);u.lang='pt-BR';u.rate=.9;u.pitch=1;u.volume=1;
 const voices=window.speechSynthesis.getVoices(),pt=voices.find(v=>v.lang.toLowerCase()==='pt-br')||voices.find(v=>v.lang.toLowerCase().startsWith('pt'));
 if(pt)u.voice=pt;window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
}
function onDialogContent(){voiceStop();if(VOICE.auto&&VOICE.available)voiceRead();}
$('voiceRead').onclick=()=>voiceRead();$('voiceStop').onclick=voiceStop;
$('voiceAutoBtn').onclick=()=>{
 if(!VOICE.available){toast('<b>Leitura em voz alta indisponível</b>Use um navegador com síntese de voz em português.');return;}
 VOICE.auto=!VOICE.auto;$('voiceAutoBtn').textContent=VOICE.auto?'🔊 Leitura automática: sim':'🔊 Leitura automática: não';
 $('voiceAutoBtn').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(VOICE.auto));
 if(VOICE.auto&&!$('dlg').hidden)voiceRead();else voiceStop();
};
const _dlgBasic=dlg;
dlg=function(role,who,html,btns){_dlgBasic(role,who,html,btns);onDialogContent();};

// interação no meio da conversa: escolher, separar ou ordenar
function ixFb(el,ok,txt){el.querySelector('.fbx').innerHTML=`<div class="fb ${ok?'ok':'no'}"><b>${ok?'Isso mesmo!':'Ainda não.'}</b> ${txt}</div>`;
  if(ok)setTimeout(()=>{const d=$('dlg');d.scrollTop=d.scrollHeight;},30);}
function runIx(it,el,done){let tries=0;
  const head=`<div class="tag">${it.kind}</div><div class="q">${it.ask}</div>`;
  if(it.type==='pick'){const order=shuffle(it.opts.map((_,i)=>i));
    el.innerHTML=head+'<div class="opts">'+order.map(i=>`<button class="ghost" data-i="${i}">${it.opts[i]}</button>`).join('')+'</div><div class="fbx"></div>';
    el.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const i=+b.dataset.i;tries++;
      if(i===it.c){b.classList.add('right');el.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(x=>x.disabled=true);ixFb(el,true,it.ok);done(tries===1);}
      else{b.classList.add('wrong');b.disabled=true;ixFb(el,false,it.no||'Releia o que foi dito e tente de novo.');}});}
  if(it.type==='tag'){const ans=it.items.map(()=>null);
    el.innerHTML=head+it.items.map(([txt],r)=>`<div class="trow" data-r="${r}"><span>${txt}</span>${it.labels.map((L,j)=>`<button class="ghost" data-r="${r}" data-j="${j}">${L}</button>`).join('')}</div>`).join('')
      +'<div class="fbx"></div><button id="ixCheck">Conferir</button>';
    el.querySelectorAll('.trow button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const r=+b.dataset.r,j=+b.dataset.j;ans[r]=j;
      el.querySelectorAll(`.trow button[data-r="${r}"]`).forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on',x===b));el.querySelector(`.trow[data-r="${r}"]`).classList.remove('bad');});
    el.querySelector('#ixCheck').onclick=()=>{if(ans.some(a=>a===null)){ixFb(el,false,'Escolha uma resposta em cada linha.');return;}tries++;let bad=0;
      it.items.forEach(([_,c],r)=>{const ok=ans[r]===c;el.querySelector(`.trow[data-r="${r}"]`).classList.toggle('bad',!ok);if(!ok)bad++;});
      if(!bad){el.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(x=>x.disabled=true);el.querySelector('#ixCheck').hidden=true;ixFb(el,true,it.ok);done(tries===1);}
      else ixFb(el,false,bad===1?'Uma linha está errada (em vermelho). Troque a resposta e confira de novo.':`${bad} linhas estão erradas (em vermelho). Troque e confira de novo.`);};}
  if(it.type==='order'){let pos=0;const sh=it.items.map((_,i)=>i).sort(()=>rnd()-.5);
    el.innerHTML=head+'<div class="opts">'+sh.map(i=>`<button class="ghost" data-i="${i}"><span class="ordn">·</span>${it.items[i]}</button>`).join('')+'</div><div class="fbx"></div>';
    el.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const i=+b.dataset.i;
      if(i===pos){b.classList.add('right');b.disabled=true;b.querySelector('.ordn').textContent=(pos+1)+'.';pos++;el.querySelector('.fbx').innerHTML='';
        if(pos===it.items.length){ixFb(el,true,it.ok);done(tries===0);}}
      else{tries++;b.classList.add('shake');setTimeout(()=>b.classList.remove('shake'),500);ixFb(el,false,it.no||'Esse ainda não. Qual veio antes?');}});}}
function hideDlg(){voiceStop();$('dlg').hidden=true;dlgClose=null;}
function releaseInput(){for(const k in keys)keys[k]=false;if(joy.id!==null){try{$('joy').releasePointerCapture(joy.id);}catch(e){}}joy.id=null;joy.x=joy.y=0;$('knob').style.transform='';}
function lock(){$('interact').hidden=true;releaseInput();P.locked=true;$('card').hidden=true;nearPlace=null;$('joy').hidden=true;}
let curN=null,quietN=null;
function unlock(){hideDlg();releaseInput();P.locked=false;P.cool=.8;$('joy').hidden=false;quietN=curN;curN=null;try{canvas.focus({preventScroll:true});}catch(e){}}
function talkDialog(t){lock();curN=t;dlgClose=unlock;let k=0,ixDone=false;const it=t.ix,at=it?Math.min(it.at??99,t.pages.length-1):-1;
  const show=()=>{const last=k===t.pages.length-1,pg=t.pages[k]+`<div class="pg">${k+1} / ${t.pages.length}</div>`;
    const btns=last?[{t:'Voltar a passear ▸',main:true,f:()=>{S.talks[t.id]=1;setDone(t);renderTasks();unlock();}}]:[{t:'Continuar ▸',main:true,f:()=>{k++;show();}}];
    if(k===at&&!ixDone){dlg('Conversa na rua',t.who,pg+'<div class="ix"></div>',[]);
      runIx(it,$('dTxt').querySelector('.ix'),first=>{ixDone=true;S.att[t.id]=first?1:0;renderTasks();setBtns(btns);});return;}
    dlg('Conversa na rua',t.who,pg,btns);};
  show();}

// ---------- colisão ----------
function collide(lx,lz){
  if(inPalace){palaceCollide();return;}
  for(const c of colliders){
    if(c.seg){const[ax,az,bx,bz]=c.seg,vx=bx-ax,vz=bz-az;let t=((P.x-ax)*vx+(P.z-az)*vz)/(vx*vx+vz*vz);t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));
      const qx=ax+vx*t,qz=az+vz*t,dx=P.x-qx,dz=P.z-qz,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz),Rr=c.r+.4;if(d<Rr&&d>1e-6){P.x=qx+dx/d*Rr;P.z=qz+dz/d*Rr;}continue;}
    if(c.r){let dx=P.x-c.x,dz=P.z-c.z,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz);if(d<1e-6){dx=1;dz=0;d=1;}if(d<c.r+.4){P.x=c.x+dx/d*(c.r+.4);P.z=c.z+dz/d*(c.r+.4);}continue;}
    const dx=P.x-c.x,dz=P.z-c.z,co=Math.cos(c.rot||0),si=Math.sin(c.rot||0);
    let ux=dx*co-dz*si,uz=dx*si+dz*co;const hw=c.hw+.42,hd=c.hd+.42;
    if(Math.abs(ux)<hw&&Math.abs(uz)<hd){const px=hw-Math.abs(ux),pz=hd-Math.abs(uz);
      if(px<pz)ux=Math.sign(ux||1)*hw;else uz=Math.sign(uz||1)*hd;
      P.x=c.x+ux*co+uz*si;P.z=c.z-ux*si+uz*co;}}
  if(H(P.x,P.z)<-.25){P.x=lx;P.z=lz;}
  bloquearTravessia(lx,lz);
  P.x=Math.max(-150,Math.min(60,P.x));P.z=Math.max(-135,Math.min(115,P.z));}

const RIO_SOUND={ctx:null,on:false,nextCannon:22,nextHoof:3,nextBell:10,nextDrum:1,drumBeat:0};
function rioAudioReady(){const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!AC)return null;
 if(!RIO_SOUND.ctx)RIO_SOUND.ctx=new AC();if(RIO_SOUND.ctx.state==='suspended')RIO_SOUND.ctx.resume();return RIO_SOUND.ctx;}
function rioSoundCannon(){const ac=RIO_SOUND.on&&rioAudioReady();if(!ac)return;
 const len=Math.round(ac.sampleRate*.9),buffer=ac.createBuffer(1,len,ac.sampleRate),data=buffer.getChannelData(0);
 for(let i=0;i<len;i++){const t=i/len;data[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*Math.exp(-5.5*t);}
 const source=ac.createBufferSource(),low=ac.createBiquadFilter(),gain=ac.createGain();source.buffer=buffer;
 low.type='lowpass';low.frequency.value=240;gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,ac.currentTime);
 gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.045,ac.currentTime+.03);
 gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,ac.currentTime+.87);
 source.connect(low);low.connect(gain);gain.connect(ac.destination);source.start();source.stop(ac.currentTime+.9);
}
function rioSoundHoof(){const ac=RIO_SOUND.on&&rioAudioReady();if(!ac)return;
 const osc=ac.createOscillator(),g=ac.createGain();osc.type='triangle';osc.frequency.value=130;
 g.gain.setValueAtTime(.015,ac.currentTime);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,ac.currentTime+.07);
 osc.connect(g);g.connect(ac.destination);osc.start();osc.stop(ac.currentTime+.075);
}
// Badaladas de sinos de igrejas, harmônicos decaindo como um sino metálico.
function rioSoundBell(){const ac=RIO_SOUND.on&&rioAudioReady();if(!ac)return;
 const tm=ac.currentTime;
 for(const [mul,gain,decay] of [[1,.023,2.6],[2.01,.009,2.1],[2.98,.005,1.7],[4.25,.003,1.25]]){
   const osc=ac.createOscillator(),amp=ac.createGain();osc.type='sine';osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(360*mul,tm);
   amp.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,tm);amp.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(gain,tm+.022);amp.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,tm+decay);
   osc.connect(amp);amp.connect(ac.destination);osc.start(tm);osc.stop(tm+decay+.03);
 }
}
// Percussão original sintetizada: tambores e palmas, sem gravações nem trilhas protegidas.
function rioSoundDrum(type='grave',volume=.055){const ac=RIO_SOUND.on&&rioAudioReady();if(!ac)return;
 const tm=ac.currentTime;
 if(type==='grave'){
  const osc=ac.createOscillator(),amp=ac.createGain();osc.type='sine';osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(145,tm);osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(55,tm+.15);
  amp.gain.setValueAtTime(volume,tm);amp.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,tm+.22);osc.connect(amp);amp.connect(ac.destination);osc.start(tm);osc.stop(tm+.24);
 }else{
  const len=Math.floor(ac.sampleRate*.12),buffer=ac.createBuffer(1,len,ac.sampleRate),samples=buffer.getChannelData(0);
  for(let i=0;i<len;i++)samples[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*Math.exp(-i/len*11);
  const source=ac.createBufferSource(),filter=ac.createBiquadFilter(),amp=ac.createGain();source.buffer=buffer;filter.type='bandpass';filter.frequency.value=1400;
  amp.gain.value=volume*.42;source.connect(filter);filter.connect(amp);amp.connect(ac.destination);source.start(tm);source.stop(tm+.12);
 }
}

function lowerQuality(){PERF.level++;
  if(PERF.level===1){renderer.setPixelRatio(1);resize();}
  if(PERF.level===2){renderer.shadowMap.enabled=false;sun.castShadow=false;scene.traverse(o=>{const m=o.material;if(!m)return;(Array.isArray(m)?m:[m]).forEach(x=>x.needsUpdate=true);});}
  if(PERF.level===3){V18_BLOB.mat.visible=false;scene.fog.near=90;scene.fog.far=320;camera.far=520;camera.updateProjectionMatrix();CULL=60;}}

function frame(now){requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  if(started&&PERF.lastNow){PERF.acc+=now-PERF.lastNow;PERF.n++;if(PERF.n>=90){const avg=PERF.acc/PERF.n;PERF.acc=PERF.n=0;if(avg>45&&PERF.level<3&&(!window.__rioQuality||window.__rioQuality==='auto'))lowerQuality();}}
  PERF.lastNow=now;
  try{step(now);}catch(e){if(stepErr++<5)console.error(e);}
  try{renderer.render(inPalace?palaceScene:scene,camera);}catch(e){}}
